ranking_method: Ranked purely by SELECTED-status distinct-mint count (a deterministic, existing local evidence-strength indicator) in wt_walkback_edge_candidates, the same raw evidence layer that produced the OF-P0 56-launch family and the underlying tf_populations system. NOT ranked by trading profitability -- no authorized contract calls for that. Known-operation overlap is disclosed per row, not used to exclude a row from the list (excluding would hide useful information from the human).
important_caveat: counts in this table are from the RAW walkback-candidate layer (SELECTED rows only, no further 2-hop/temporal/collision analysis applied) -- they are NOT directly comparable to OF-P0's curated 56-launch figure for the same root (5tzFki...), which applied additional filtering. These are candidate-strength indicators for triage, not final family sizes.
